America, China, and the Costs of the Bipolar AI Race

We are in the age of artificial intelligence. Many are comparing the technology to electricity and describing it as the industrial revolution of this century. The United States has long dominated the field, but China’s meteoric rise has made it the strongest challenger to American dominance .
